scope: Same-team read-only audit of public saved receipts; no inference or private corpus access.
limits: Publication precedence relies on the saved anonymous-byte-equality publication receipt and matching Git commit; this audit did not repeat the network fetch.
Saved HTTP response bodies, hashes, timestamps and daemon inventories are local evidence, not external traffic or timing attestation.
Unloaded means absent from daemon residency inventory, not cleared operating-system caches. Fixed order and repeated prompts permit cache and load confounds.
Six correct startup replies do not establish useful operations advice or reliable latency across workloads.
The 60-second suggestion follows the preregistered engineering margin and requires a separate future registration. Production/scored timeout remains 20 seconds.
These measurements do not retrospectively prove the cause of the earlier generic provider failure at approximately 20 seconds.
